patterns.message: Framework-agnostic boundary: src/engine, src/interactions, src/windows, src/menus and src/dev must not import a UI framework. Vue was REMOVED from this project (docs/remove-vue-plan.md) — these patterns stay as a ratchet so it cannot creep back. All UI here is plain TS + DOM; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

no-restricted-globals.name: document
no-restricted-globals.message: Score layer: no DOM. A score must be operable with no editor and no browser — docs/DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md §5.

no-restricted-globals.message: Score layer: no browser APIs — docs/DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md §5.

no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: Score layer: no browser APIs. Persistence is the caller's job; the score offers toJSON — docs/DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md §5.

patterns.message: Score layer must not import a renderer, audio, or the editor's facade. The arrow points editor -> score, never score -> editor — docs/DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md §5.
